Earthquake felt in India after tremors in Afghanistan

A 6.2 magnitude earthquake struck the Hindu Kush region of Afghanistan, with its tremors felt across several parts of India, including Delhi-NCR and Kashmir. The earthquake's depth of 215 kilometers contributed to its widespread impact. While the tremors caused concern, initial reports suggest the risk of major damage is low due to the depth of the epicenter.
